summary: Iteration 9 tested the new Carpet Cleaning quote and approval flow and the desktop call dialog, end to end in both backend and frontend. Backend: 17/17 core pytest tests passed (tests/test_iter9_carpet.py). One extra edge-case test fails and shows a real bug (see critical). The iter8 regression suite passed 15/15. Frontend: every requested flow passed on desktop (1920) and mobile (390). /carpet-cleaning shows the hero image (/carpet/hero.jpg loads), the description, 6 included items, the disclaimer, the price block ('Prices starting from £100' plus the starting-price explanation), 8 area cards linking to ?area=KEY, 5 process steps and the CTA. The header has a Carpet nav link. /services/carpet redirects to /carpet-cleaning. The services grid carpet card shows 'Prices from £100.00' and links to /carpet-cleaning. The EoT and Regular cards are unchanged. The request form: ?area preselects; the counters, the 'other' textarea and the stairs questions (Continue stays disabled until steps >= 1), the landing yes/no and the stairs photo upload all work. The pet follow-up questions appear when pets = yes, and the treatment disclaimer shows. Multiple photos upload. The date min is tomorrow and today blocks Continue. Contact details come before the address step, which is last. Submitting shows the exact awaiting-review message. In the DB: status awaiting_review, 3 photos attached, no booking, and only owner_notification and carpet_quote_ack comms. Admin /admin/carpet-quotes: the row and detail sheet (areas, answers, photos) work; Send quote -> quoted, with the link https://{host}/carpet-cleaning/quote/{id}?t=TOKEN. Quote page: a wrong token shows carpet-quote-invalid. The accept button is disabled until the terms checkbox is ticked, then redirects to Stripe checkout (£165). After simulating payment through /payments/status: the booking is awaiting_approval/paid, the quote is accepted, and carpet_payment_received is logged once (idempotent). /payment/success shows 'Payment received - awaiting approval' with 'Back to home'. The quote page then shows the awaiting-approval status. Admin Approve -> booking confirmed, quote confirmed, booking_confirmation logged, and the quote page shows confirmed. Declining a paid quote -> booking cancelled, refund_due, full refund recorded. Validation returns 422 for an unknown area, stairs with 0 steps, a past or today date, an invalid answer key, or a count of 0. The rate limit returns 429 on the 4th request. POST /bookings with service carpet returns 422. /quote: choosing carpet shows quote-carpet-request-link and Continue goes to /carpet-cleaning/request. Call buttons (site-phone, call-strip-phone, hero-call-btn, carpet-call-btn) open call-dialog with '020 3728 4419' and the copy button, and their href is tel:+442037284419. mobile-call-btn has the href tel:+442037284419. At 390px there is no horizontal overflow on the carpet page, the request steps or the quote page. The iter8 small fixes are in the code (TipPage custom clears the preset and shows 'max £500', RefundDialog uses Math.floor, PaymentResult shows 'Back to home' for tip and carpet, unpublish no longer touches require_acceptance, cancel-refund with amount > 0 sets refund_due).

critical.issue: A declined quote can come back to life. If the customer clicked Accept (pending_payment booking and an open Stripe session) and the owner then declines, decline() only cancels bookings that are 'awaiting_approval'. The pending_payment booking and its Stripe session stay live. If the customer then pays, settle_carpet moves the booking to awaiting_approval/paid and sets the quote status back to 'accepted', overriding 'declined'. Reproduced by test_decline_while_checkout_open_then_paid (quote revived to accepted, booking awaiting_approval/paid). The same weakness exists when the owner re-sends an updated quote at a different price: an old open session at the old price can still be paid.

minor.issue: Returns email_status, but the admin UI always toasts 'Quote emailed to the customer'. In my run the email status was 'failed' (example.com / rate limit), yet the owner was told it was emailed. The UI does not show the quote link for manual sharing either.

Accepts bookings in status 'abandoned'. If two checkout sessions are opened and both are paid, both bookings become awaiting_approval and quote.booking_id is overwritten (double charge, no refund flag).
No availability or slot-conflict check for the quoted date/time, and the time is a free-text field.

ui_bugs.issue: String(v).replace(/_/g,' ') is applied to EVERY value, so free text is changed: the customer email test_carpet_ui1@example.com shows as 'test carpet ui1@example.com', and names, addresses and other_areas lose their underscores. The owner could copy a wrong email. Only replace underscores for the enum answers (e.g. not_sure).

issues: The Carpet Cleaning card says 'Priced after a short survey', but carpet is quoted from photos and starts from £100. Show 'From £100 · quoted after review' instead.
The Date field uses the native browser date input (mm/dd/yyyy) instead of the shadcn calendar. Time is a free-text input; consider the same time pills as the customer form.
The footer phone link uses tel:02037284419 (not the +44 format used elsewhere). Minor.

action_items: HIGH: In decline() (and when re-sending an updated quote), also mark pending_payment bookings for that carpet_quote_id as abandoned/cancelled and ideally expire their Stripe sessions (stripe.checkout.Session.expire). In settle_carpet, check the quote status: if the quote is declined (or the booking was abandoned), do not revive it. Mark the booking cancelled with payment_status refund_due and notify the owner instead.
MEDIUM: Admin CarpetQuotes R helper: stop replacing underscores in emails, names, addresses and free text. Only prettify the enum answer values.
Low: Use email_status from send-quote to show a warning toast and the copyable quote link when the email failed.
Low: Change the /quote carpet service card subtitle to 'From £100' instead of 'Priced after a short survey'.
critical_code_review_comments: routes_carpet.decline/settle_carpet race described above (verified by test).
routes_carpet.settle_carpet allows status 'abandoned', which leads to a possible double paid booking for one quote.
routes_carpet.AcceptIn.t and view_quote t have no max_length. compare_digest is used properly. The token is excluded from the admin list and detail (verified).
accept_quote: if stripe.checkout.Session.create raises, the pending_payment booking is left without a session (not cleaned up).
CarpetRequest.jsx: tomorrow() uses toISOString (UTC). Late evening in BST, 'tomorrow' could be computed off by one. The backend also uses the UTC date. Minor.

success_rate.backend: 94% (17/18; the 1 failure is the decline-after-open-checkout bug)
success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows passed; 1 medium display bug in admin detail
